items.title: What Is Intelligence? With David Krakauer
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, Gary O'Reilly, David Krakauer
items.content:
Why did intelligence evolve in the universe? Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, and Gary O’Reilly explore the nature of intelligence, information theory, consciousness, and whether AI is actually intelligent at all with David Krakauer, evolutionary biologist and president of the Santa Fe Institute.

items.title: Quantum Anomalies with Lara Anderson
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Jordan Klepper, Lara Anderson
items.content:

items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Paul Mecurio, Lindsey Nyx Walker
items.content:

items.title: Cosmic Queries – The Fractal Universe with Charles Liu
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, Gary O'Reilly, Charles Liu
items.content:

Neil deGrasse Tyson and co-hosts Chuck Nice and Gary O’Reilly welcome back Geek-In-Chief Charles Liu, for a grab bag covering deep space travel, fractal mathematics, multiverse theory, and what we might never know about the universe.
